analysis_scope: four independent 41-evaluation inverse histories; H0P0 is the pinned authoritative baseline

common_tau_rule.definition: max across four cases of each 41-frame trajectory minimum target-error fraction; nearest saved frame only, no interpolation

limitations: H1 lowers mean membrane stiffness; this is an extreme selective membrane-removal ablation, not physiological skin identification.
The common-tau cohort is secondary and uses nearest saved frames without interpolation.
Fold and inversion counts are warnings requiring ParaView review, not automatic vetoes.

metric_definitions.D: rest-edge-length-weighted RMS of deformed-minus-target dihedral angle on interior edges whose two incident canonical IsFace triangles both satisfy strict raw TargetRestAreaRatio < 1.0
metric_definitions.L: RMS graph Laplacian of target-normal displacement residual on all IsFace vertices
metric_definitions.activation: six-component symmetric ActivationInv on active muscle tetrahedra; I+ActivationInv eigen diagnostics
metric_definitions.area_ratio_error: rest-area-weighted RMS of deformed triangle area / target triangle area - 1
metric_definitions.quality: det(F), signed skin orientation, folds, inversions, and exact fixed/cut displacement

D/raw_contraction.definition: strict raw TargetRestAreaRatio < 1.0 on canonical IsFace triangles
D/raw_contraction.interior_edge_rule: both incident triangles satisfy raw TargetRestAreaRatio < 1.0

paraview.renderer: ParaView 6.1.1 only; Matplotlib geometry render is prohibited
